segments.name: Research & Development
segments.description: Tests drug candidates in human liver and intestine tissue models for pharmaceutical and biotech partners.
segments.evidence: The R&D segment focuses on providing testing of drugs and drug candidates in 3D human tissue models of liver and intestine, offering partners liver and intestinal toxicology insights using its NAM models.

revenueModel.text: Licensing partners pay upfront fees and royalties on their net product sales; the company also sells testing and bespoke services to pharmaceutical and biotech partners.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company has entered into a license agreement with a company that includes the following: (i) non-refundable upfront fees and (ii) royalties based on specified percentages of net product sales, if any.

changes.text: In March 2025 the company sold its FXR program.
changes.evidence: In March 2025, we sold our FXR program for $10.0 million, with $9.0 million paid at closing and $1.0 million held in escrow for a period of 15 months, with future milestones of up to $50.0 million in the aggregate to be paid if the lead asset, FXR314, hits key development, regulatory and commercial milestones.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the company ended the commercial operations of its former Mosaic product division.
changes.evidence: The Company ended Mosaic's commercial operations during the third quarter of fiscal 2025.

changes.text: In April 2025 the company renamed itself VivoSim Labs, Inc. to reflect its new business model.
changes.evidence: Effective April 24, 2025, we changed our corporate name to VivoSim Labs, Inc. by filing a Certificate of Amendment to our Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware.
